name: Depth-Chart Replacement (measured NULL on the breakout template)
mechanism_text: A depth-chart promotion signals a VACANCY (injury/trade/benching ahead of the promoted player), not a breakout. The promoted player's next-week production regresses below comparable non-promoted players in every prior-production band; the vacated targets disperse rather than transfer.

magnitude_ladder.mag: expect STAR-scale mean reversion (-75 yds), not the star's production
small positive drift (+4.9) but BELOW the no-move baseline (+8.5)

falsifiers: a season split where promoted players OUT-produce matched non-promoted in any band (would revive the breakout template)
role-weighted snap-share data contradicting the depth-slot finding
use_in_decision: SHADOW weight 0; usable as a DOWN-weight (fade promoted players' props) only after calibration on 2026
anti_template: this entry REPLACES the popular 'depth bump = breakout' template, which the data kills
